pages.text: A Radiant Resonator produces a cluster of Raw Radiant Quartz in the block above itself once every five minutes. Once Quartz is produced, the process halts until the block above the Resonator is cleared.$(br2)

You can only place up to three Radiant Resonators. Any further Resonators you attempt to place will pop off, and any Resonators placed by automated means will destroy themselves.$(br2)Radiant Resonators only run while $(italics)you're$() online, even if the chunk is loaded.
Using a $(l:items/scepter_revelation)Scepter of Revelation$() on a Radiant Resonator will return its current process, and whether it is running or not.
pages.title: Scepter of Revelation

pages.text: When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Resonator outputs a signal based on its progress towards creating a new $(l:blocks/raw_quartz_cluster)Radiant Quartz Cluster$().
pages.title: Redstone Comparator

pages.text: Radiant Resonators can be crafted conventionally.
